messages.subject: Project Quartz — closing items and royalty model
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Closing items: (1) conformed copies of the licence and side letter are attached to the bible; (2) we've updated the royalty model on the executed 5.0%/£1.25m terms for your finance team - it shows c.£3.25m NPV of royalties over ten years plus the upfront; (3) Hartington IP will note the exclusive licence against the patents. Our final invoice will follow shortly.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
